title: ABP-Style Pediatric Myocarditis Question Bank

rendering.exam_mode: Hide answer, rationale, option_explanations, board_pearl, concept, difficulty, and sources until grading.
rendering.option_shuffling_rule: Randomize all five choices at render time and recompute displayed A-E labels and the displayed correct-answer letter. Do not expose the canonical stored answer position.
rendering.grading_mode: Show the correct answer, overall rationale, explanation for every answer choice, board pearl, concept, and difficulty.
rendering.stacking: Serve exactly 10 questions at a time unless a caller explicitly requests another count.

schema.options: canonical A-E option map; UI must shuffle before display
schema.answer: canonical correct option key; never expose in exam mode
schema.rationale: why the correct answer is best
schema.option_explanations: explanation for each canonical A-E option

coverage: dilated cardiomyopathy and inherited cardiomyopathy differentials
cardiac MRI and ischemic vs nonischemic injury patterns
recovery, residual dysfunction, scar, rhythm surveillance
